meta.description: Maxor OS is a NixOS + Hyprland distribution with its own identity: themed with one command, installed offline and reproducible on any machine.
nav.label: Main
hero.lead: A declarative Hyprland desktop. Themed with one command, installed offline and reproducible on any machine.
tour.title: It looks the way you pictured it. From the first boot.
desk.label: The Maxor OS desktop: floating bar, terminal, themes and configuration
tour.s1.title: Everything in its place.
tour.s1.body: Hyprland with Maxor Shell: a floating bar, launcher, notifications, control centre and its own lock screen. Nothing to configure before you start.
tour.s2.title: One theme. One command.
tour.s2.body: changes the bar, the terminal, Hyprland, GTK and the lock screen at once. No sudo and no rebuild; maxor theme undo takes it back.
tour.s3.title: Readable by day and by night.
tour.s3.body: Maxor Dark and Maxor Light come from the same palette. Every colour pair clears a 5:1 contrast, and a test checks it on every change.
tour.s4.title: Pick yours.
tour.s4.body: Six dark and six light, one accent each. Try them here: the desktop is painted with each theme's real colours.
nix.title: The whole system in one file.
nix.lead: Boot, shell, terminal, lock screen, fonts and themes live in one NixOS flake. A change is a file; going back is picking the previous generation.
nix.note: Every change creates a new generation and leaves the earlier ones untouched. You can also pick them in the boot menu.
inst.title: Installs offline, in any language.
inst.lead: A full-screen guide that writes nothing to the disk until you confirm. It proposes the keyboard and the time zone from the system's language, draws the disk map and, if something fails, says what and why.
inst.caption: The guide speaks English for now; the system ends up in the language you choose, with every language on the ISO.
inst.p1.b: The ISO carries everything it needs, every language included.
inst.p2.b: Nothing touches the disk before a typed confirmation.
inst.p3.b: LUKS for the whole system, with its passphrase at boot.
inst.p4.b: Every stage keeps its log and can be resumed.
more.title: Thought through, end to end.
more.boot.t: From power on to the desktop, no flicker.
more.boot.b: Its own splash, no menu when there is a single system and the theme written before the login. About 3.5 seconds faster.
more.gpu.b: Drivers picked from the detected hardware and PRIME offload set up:
more.apps.b: from nixpkgs and Flathub, plus usage profiles: gaming, development, creative work and office.
more.upd.b: Every release is signed with the project's key. What does not carry that signature is refused, and an old release cannot pass for a new one.
more.rep.b: The flake pins every version. Your laptop and a brand new machine end up identical.
dl.title: Take it to your machine.
dl.iso.1: Write it to a USB stick (Ventoy, dd or Fedora Media Writer).
dl.iso.2: Boot in UEFI mode. The ISO is not signed yet: turn Secure Boot off.
dl.iso.3: Follow the installer. It needs no network.
